title: List every VCF Automation project across an access-token expiry
prompt: Implement the missing VCF Automation client in `VcfAutomationClient.java`. The supplied `docs/contract.json` is the contract for this task; it was derived from the VCF Automation 9.1 reference documentation because this API is not published as a specification in `vmware/vcf-api-specs`. Keep the client implementation in this single Java source file and use only the Java 17 standard library. Preserve the public constructor and `listProjectNames()` signature used by `tests/TestMain.java`. Exchange the configured API refresh token for an access token, use that bearer token to retrieve every page of projects, and return all project names in ascending Java `String` order. If an access token expires during pagination and a project request returns HTTP 401, obtain a fresh access token and retry the interrupted request without discarding names already collected. Treat other non-success responses as errors. The test harness uses a contract-pinned loopback service, varies collection element order between responses, and inspects its request log; it never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
